siteConfig.name: Ntambag Brothers CIG
siteConfig.tagline: Empowering Children and Communities in Cameroon
siteConfig.description: Ntambag Brothers Common Initiative Group (CIG) is a nonprofit community organization in Bamenda, North West Region of Cameroon dedicated to youth empowerment, education, healthcare, and social development.
siteConfig.address: Ntambag quarter, Old Town, Bamenda, North West Region, Cameroon

heroSlides.title: Building Stronger Communities Together
heroSlides.subtitle: Supporting underprivileged children, youth, and families through education, sports, and health initiatives in Bamenda, Cameroon.

heroSlides.title: Empowering Youth Through Education
heroSlides.subtitle: Providing essential school supplies, scholarships, and academic support to ensure every child reaches their full potential.

heroSlides.title: Healthcare & Community Outreach
heroSlides.subtitle: Partnering with global and local health organizations to offer medical screening, blood tests, and health education.

programs.title: Back-to-School Support & Education
programs.summary: Providing textbooks, writing materials, bags, and tuition assistance to vulnerable children and orphans in Bamenda.
programs.description: Every academic year, Ntambag Brothers CIG organizes back-to-school support ceremonies to ensure children affected by socio-economic challenges continue their education without disruption. We distribute exercise books, pens, school uniforms, and offer fee assistance.
programs.impact: Over 500 children provided with learning materials across multiple academic years.

programs.title: Community Health & Screening Campaigns
programs.summary: Free medical checkups, blood sugar & pressure screenings, health consultation in partnership with OTFA and medical professionals.
programs.description: In collaboration with Old Town For America (OTFA) and local health personnel, we conduct community healthcare outreach campaigns in Bamenda, serving hundreds of residents with free diagnostic tests, medicines, and preventive health education.
programs.impact: More than 1,000 residents screened and provided with health counseling and medicine.

programs.title: IDP & Vulnerable Family Relief
programs.summary: Food items, warm clothing, hygiene products, and emergency relief for internally displaced persons.
programs.description: Providing humanitarian relief, food packages, blankets, and essential household items to internally displaced families residing in Ntambag quarter and surrounding Bamenda communities.
programs.impact: Direct relief provided to 200+ displaced families.

programs.title: Youth Football & Talent Development
programs.summary: Organizing holiday football tournaments and youth athletic programs to foster unity, discipline, and healthy living.
programs.description: Sports serve as a powerful tool for social cohesion. Ntambag Brothers CIG hosts annual youth football tournaments, equipping teams with jerseys, footballs, and awards to keep youth positively engaged during holiday periods.
programs.impact: Engaged over 300 youth players across regional holiday competitions.

news.title: Annual Back-to-School Distribution 2024 Successful
news.summary: Dozens of children in Bamenda received textbooks, backpacks, and financial assistance ahead of the new academic year.
news.content: Ntambag Brothers CIG held its annual Back-to-School supply distribution at the community center in Old Town, Bamenda. Over 100 students received essential learning tools to prepare them for academic success.

news.title: Health Campaign Partnership with OTFA
news.summary: Free diagnostic medical screening and consultation provided to community members in Ntambag.
news.content: In partnership with Old Town For America (OTFA), Ntambag Brothers CIG hosted a 2-day free medical camp. Doctors and nurses conducted screenings for blood pressure, blood glucose, and malaria.

news.title: New Year Community Fellowship & Support 2025
news.summary: Members and community elders gather to share food, goodwill, and plan emergency relief projects for the year.
news.content: The executive board and general assembly hosted a celebration and fellowship meal for elderly residents and vulnerable families in Ntambag quarter.
